content.short: Captivate is a Cardano-linked tabletop card game focused on fantasy strategy, skill, memory, and collectibles.
content.description: Captivate is a fast-paced tabletop card game from Frostlore Games, built around strategy, skill, and memory for two to four players. The project has released a Cardano Edition as a print-on-demand and print-and-play product while also reworking the wider game into a fantasy setting with its own world and story. Its connection to Cardano sits in the NFT and collectible-game space, where physical card play, digital community, and themed releases can support a broader game universe for players and collectors.
